summary: A planned master change settles its Controller task when the transfer finishes, repository checks at activation are bounded, offline-adopted NFS and SMB3 repositories remount on the next probe, orphan-cleanup records travel with the signed backup authority, and stale backup receipts no longer block a master change.

guide.reason: Network-share repositories now recover by themselves after a master change, a stale receipt no longer blocks one, and the hand-off message changed.

api.reason: The peer backup authority gains an orphan_cleanups record list and manifest count; no endpoint changes. The OpenAPI contracts and generated references are updated.

roadmap.reason: Fixes inside the backup recovery plan.

state.record: The pool master's pool-backup-orphan-cleanups records, now carried in the signed backup authority pages and staged on the new master at activation.
state.reason: A fresh Controller reads cleanup results from the new master through the existing orphan-cleanups endpoint.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent and the full internal/agent, protocol, controller and localcore suites; no lab run.
